{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
# First, inspect to confirm format
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders and QA orders
# QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'

# Apply filters: keep only completed orders with valid revenue
valid_orders = df[~refunded_mask & ~qa_mask]

# Check the number of valid orders
print(f'Number of valid orders after filtering: {len(valid_orders)}')

# Group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = valid_orders.groupby('channel', observed=True)['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Get the channel with highest revenue
best_channel = channel_revenue.idxmax()
best_revenue = channel_revenue.max()

# Print results
channel_revenue, best_channel, best_revenue"}
